name: lemlist
summary: Multichannel prospecting tool with a lead database and sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls and WhatsApp.
description: lemlist finds prospects in a database of more than 650 million leads, verifies emails and phone numbers, and runs multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS and WhatsApp with a unified inbox and deliverability tools. Plans start at $69 per month ($55 billed annually) for the email plan, with a free trial; no permanent free plan was shown. Lead finding and outreach can also be run from a CRM or an AI assistant.

howToUse.title: Open lemlist
howToUse.description: Open lemlist and start a free trial, or request a demo, to reach the outbound workspace.

howToUse.title: Find prospects and verify contacts
howToUse.description: Search the database of more than 650 million prospects, then use the finder that verifies emails and phone numbers before any outreach.

howToUse.title: Launch multichannel sequences
howToUse.description: Build multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS and WhatsApp, follow replies in the unified inbox, and watch deliverability. The same outreach can also run from a CRM or an AI assistant.

features: Multichannel prospecting tool with a lead database and sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls and WhatsApp.

lemlist finds prospects in a database of more than 650 million leads, verifies emails and phone numbers, and runs multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS and WhatsApp with a unified inbox and deliverability tools.
Plans start at $69 per month ($55 billed annually) for the email plan, with a free trial; no permanent free plan was shown.
Lead finding and outreach can also be run from a CRM or an AI assistant.
features_fr: Outil de prospection multicanal avec une base de données de leads et des séquences via e-mail, LinkedIn, appels et WhatsApp.

lemlist trouve des prospects dans une base de données de plus de 650 millions de leads, vérifie les e-mails et les numéros de téléphone et exécute des séquences multicanaux sur les e-mails, LinkedIn, les appels, les SMS et WhatsApp avec une boîte de réception unifiée et des outils de délivrabilité.
Les forfaits commencent à 69 $ par mois (55 $ facturés annuellement) pour le forfait de messagerie, avec un essai gratuit ; aucun plan gratuit permanent n’a été affiché.
La recherche de leads et la sensibilisation peuvent également être exécutées à partir d'un CRM ou d'un assistant IA.
